about: How timing becomes accuracy. Each note earns full credit when it lands within `fullFraction` of the gap to its nearest neighbouring note, falling smoothly to nothing at `zeroFraction` of that gap; both windows are kept between their Min and Max in milliseconds, so sixteenths at 160 are not judged like eighths at 80. A missed note earns nothing; each extra note counts as `extraWeight` of a note that earned nothing. Accuracy is the credit over the notes asked for plus the extras. Tune here; bump index.json version. The app has the same numbers as its default.
